name: Skeleton Knight
description: A large armored skeleton with a huge blade.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.description: When the Knight makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Cut to the Bone
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take 1d8+2 physical damage and must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Dig Two Graves
abilities.description: When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes 1d4+8 physical damage and loses 1d4 Hope.
